title: Demonstration mode
intro: Loads a small fictional clinic so every screen in the app has something real to show. Use it for training and for walkthroughs.

banner.label: Demonstration data
banner.body: These are invented records for training and demonstration. No part of this is a real patient, and the recordings are synthetic test tones, not lung sounds.
banner.short: Demonstration data — not a real patient

toggle.label: Show demonstration data
toggle.hintOn: Fictional records are visible throughout the app, each marked as demonstration data.
toggle.hintOff: Only real records are shown. Any demonstration data stays on the device, hidden.

status.heading: On this device
status.empty: No demonstration data has been loaded.

actions.confirmRemove: Remove every demonstration record from this device? Real patient records are not affected.

walkthrough.heading: Where to start
walkthrough.body: Open {{name}}. She has asthma and {{count}} assessments over the past two months, so her results show a trend rather than a single reading.

audio.heading: About the recordings
audio.body: Every demonstration recording plays the same kind of synthetic test tone. Nothing here is a lung sound and nothing here should be judged clinically.

errors.load: Could not load the demonstration data.
errors.remove: Could not remove the demonstration data.
